en.stolac_body: Located in the Herzegovina-Neretva Canton of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, Stolac is a captivating town nestled in the picturesque region of Herzegovina. Positioned along the tourist route that traverses Herzegovina, it serves as a vital link connecting the mountainous Bosnian hinterland with the coastal regions of Bosnia and Herzegovina, Dubrovnik, and Montenegro. Situated in the Herzegovina Humina area, Stolac benefits from a strategic location on a route spanning from Sarajevo through Mostar, Stolac, Ljubinje, and Trebinje — reaching Dubrovnik in under 4 hours. Thanks to its rich hunting grounds and other natural advantages, Stolac and its surroundings have been inhabited since ancient times by prehistoric communities, the Illyrians, Romans, and Slavs, all of whom left behind a wealth of anthropological evidence.

voices.quote: Stolac surprised us completely. We arrived expecting a transit stop on the way to Dubrovnik and ended up staying an extra night. The room was spotless, the host genuinely welcoming.
voices.author: Nicolas

voices.quote: The apartment is well-equipped and quiet at night — everything you need for a comfortable stay. Walking distance to the old town and the bridge. We will come back.
voices.author: Carina

voices.quote: The hosts were kind and helpful, and the town itself is absolutely worth the detour. One of the most beautiful places in the whole Balkans.
voices.author: Marija

Uživajte u dodatnoj pogodnosti besplatnog privatnog parkirališta, a za one željne istraživanja okolice nudimo usluge najma automobila. Iskusite udobnost i pogodnosti u Guesthouse Check In Stolac.

bs.stolac_body: Smješten u Hercegovačko-neretvanskom kantonu Federacije Bosne i Hercegovine, Stolac je zadivljujući grad smješten u slikovitoj regiji Hercegovine. Postavljen duž turističke rute koja prolazi kroz Hercegovinu, služi kao vitalna poveznica koja spaja planinsko bosansko zaleđe s primorskim regijama Bosne i Hercegovine, Dubrovnika i Crne Gore. Smješten u području Hercegovačke Humine, Stolac ima prednosti strateškog položaja na ruti od Sarajeva preko Mostara, Stoca, Ljubinja i Trebinja — putovanje do Dubrovnika traje manje od 4 sata. Zahvaljujući bogatim lovištima i prirodnim ljepotama, Stolac i njegova okolica bila je nastanjena od pretpovijesnih zajednica, Ilira, Rimljana i Slavena, koji su za sobom ostavili obilje antropoloških dokaza.

voices.quote: Stolac nas je potpuno iznenadio. Stigli smo kao tranzitna stanica na putu za Dubrovnik i na kraju ostali ekstra noć. Soba je bila besprijekorna, domaćin iskreno dobrodošao.
voices.author: Nicolas

voices.quote: Apartman je dobro opremljen i tih noću — sve što vam treba za ugodan boravak. Pješačka udaljenost do starog grada i mosta. Svakako se vraćamo.
voices.author: Carina

voices.quote: Domaćini su bili ljubazni i od pomoći, a sam grad apsolutno vrijedi zaobilaznice. Jedno od najljepših mjesta na cijelom Balkanu.
voices.author: Marija
